text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's that?! Y'can make snow that doesn't melt?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text: Yep. I saw a video online saying you can make it by mixing baking soda and conditioner!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I've gotta give that a shot!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hot dog, this stuff's powdery! It's way more realistic than I was expect'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Maybe if I try putt'n it in the fridge for a while, it'll get even more realistic! I hope it even crunches when I walk on it…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh… But what I'm really miss'n… is real snow.
